falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern assumed a higher low formation; a break below this level invalidates the structural support thesis and suggests the 'bottom' was not in fact a bottom, making the HOLD signal erroneous

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies contained volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and regime change to risk-off, falsifying the pattern's assumption of orderly accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further below -50bps (more negative than -0.50%)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern match to August 2024 bottom assumed improving financial conditions; deepening inversion signals credit stress and recession acceleration, contradicting the macro stabilization premise underlying the HOLD verdict

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
